verdict.rationale: SendGrid is a SaaS email API, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only the REST API, SMTP, SDKs, webhooks, an llms.txt file and markdown docs. None of these documents an official MCP server, and AI-readable docs are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
